column5: - SA:1545-1547: `admits_machine` returns `true` for every machine when membership is `Selected` and the artifact has no scalar conditions. Reader's wrong program: an invocation-scoped admission admits a machine outside the reachable set. Callers not traced.

- SA:163-169 (`include_evaluation_entry` does nothing for Source scopes); SA:826-828 (entry prerequisite owned by a layout observation is dropped; reader inferred it is checked when that application is demanded, not traced); SA:1910-1929 (`finish` runs the "no target application" coverage check only for kind `Source`); SA:2181-2183.

- resources.rs:1439-1466: run relocation checks a sample of cells. Reader's wrong program: a destination profile that differs at an interior cell away from region boundaries. No test varies an interior cell (AP/tests.rs:2790-2825 varies the last cell).

- arena.rs:1023-1038: a stale-generation handle reads the dummy row; `get_mut` on an invalid handle mutates the dummy (1033-1037); `span_or_empty` turns an unresolvable span into an empty slice (1113-1137). Same in paged.rs:462-476, 1093-1095, 1486-1512. Wrong program: a caller that does not check validity reads default content for a dangling handle.
- owned_index.rs:92-97: `with_updated` marks a stale index as seen when `update` returns `None`. paged.rs:1726-1730, 1967-1971: interners compare equal to everything.
- compiler-storage lib.rs:402-408: `generation` returns the original unchanged when no remap domain is registered (whether every decode registers its domains: not traced).
- invocation.rs:344-367 (`release_storage` uses `debug_assert!` then unchecked subtraction); evaluation-accounting lib.rs:272, 289, 304 (three sponsor charges work for either measurement).

- extents lib.rs:414-456, 691-713: `from_established_program_local` and `from_admitted_provider` are public constructors with no proof argument. mapping.rs:52-80, 746-751: `MappingGrant::from_admitted_provider` validates nothing and mapped rights come from the grant; reader's wrong program: a grant that widens rights. mapping.rs:257: empty obligation sets make the fact check vacuous. loans_and_claims.rs:1412: empty roles and empty events are admitted (no users outside the crate).
